name: B10-0224/2026 (ESN) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament states its opinion on Venezuela's new Amnesty Law. It says the law is flawed: it covers only some periods, leaves out many detainees, and is run by courts still controlled by the old regime. It also criticises the United States for removing Nicolas Maduro by military force, calling that a violation of Venezuela's sovereignty. The Parliament asks for real judicial independence and accountability instead of a law it sees as a public relations exercise.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its position on Venezuela's Amnesty Law.
- It concerns Venezuela's government, courts, military and political detainees.
- The resolution is sent to European Union bodies, member states and Venezuelan authorities.
